svg.text: swift run SchemaMigrationDemo
SchemaMigrationKit demo — versioned contracts for structured output
1. A v1 payload from last year's cache, read by today's v3 code
stored (v1) {city: "Shimla", headline: "Heavy snowfall expected overnight", severity: 4}
path v1 -> v3 (2 steps) [upgrade]
migrated {city: "Shimla", confidence: 0.5, headline: "Heavy snowfall expected overnight", issuedAtTick: 42, severity: "high"}
steps run 2 dropped 0 field(s)
2. Is the change breaking? Ask before shipping, not after
v1 -> v2 compatible
v2 -> v3 BREAKING
- field 'severity' changed type integer -> string
- required field 'issuedAtTick' added
3. A step that claims v2 and does not deliver it
refused postconditionViolated(contract: search.tool, step: "v1 -> v2", version: v2, violations: [missing required field 'locale'])
note the caller never receives the half-migrated payload
thrown step stepFailed(contract: search.tool, from: v1, to: v2, message: "localeLookupUnavailable")
4. Serving a v1 client from a v3 payload
refused lossyMigrationRefused(contract: weather.alert, from: v3, to: v1, drops: ["confidence", "issuedAtTick"])
allowed {city: "Shimla", headline: "Heavy snowfall expected overnight", severity: 4}
dropped confidence, issuedAtTick
5. Negotiation, deprecation, and the hops nobody registered
v1 -> v3 @0 migrate v1 -> v3 (2 steps)
v3 -> v2 @0 unsupported: v3 -> v2 would drop issuedAtTick
v1 at 250 sunset since tick 200
v2 -> v1 @250 unsupported: consumer version v1 is sunset since tick 200
out of v1 ok at tick 250 — v1 -> v3 (2 steps), severity now "low"
coverage search.tool [v1 -> v2] upgrade gaps 0, downgrade gaps 1
missing v2 -> v1
